events.title: Prague honours Roma resistance fighters against Hitler
events.description: More than 1,400 Roma fought against the German Nazi occupation in Czechoslovakia. A new exhibition in Prague showcases the stories of partisans and soldiers whose fates barely received any attention for decades.

events.title: New York Archdiocese to pay $800 million to sex abuse survivors

events.title: Nigeria: Tinubu launches reelection bid amid economic woes

events.title: EU moves to loosen rules on pesticide use as experts sound the alarm
events.description: The European Union wants to relax rules for pesticides, saying it will be easier for farmers to adopt more environmentally friendly options. But health and environmental experts say the risks are far too great.

events.title: Voting under way across Brazil in tight presidential run-off between Lula and Bolsonaro
events.description: Brazil’s 158 million voters decide between leftist President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing challenger Senator Flavio Bolsonaro – the son of former president and Trump ally Jair Bolsonaro – following a highly charged run-off campaign period, with the candidates in a dead heat in polls. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.
